subject.why: The tricorn hat is instantly recognisable with its turned-up brim edged in gold, skull-and-crossbones emblem, and red feather.

category.why: The hat floats cleanly in three-quarter view against a gradient background with repeated anchor motifs, fully adhering to category 1.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, border, watermark, or character present.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with generous, balanced margins around all edges.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and juicy, with the dark hat contrasting boldly against the saturated yellow background.

detail.why: Forms are chunky, smooth, and simplified without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: The 3D satin sheen, soft rounded volumes, and absence of outlines match the reference game style seamlessly.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (97% of the background); planned yellow
